title: Is this really a crash? We are not even down 5%
summary: Genuinely curious as I was not there to trade during dot com bubble or GFC of 2008. We are not even 10% down. I don’t think AI valuation is crazy either other than few speculative ones. But the fear and greed index is extreme fear, many are talking about cutting losses ( regular stocks; not even derivatives). I am down 24% on my META calls. But I think it is an idiosyncratic case. My question to veterans is this how it feels when the long bear market starts? Or is it again those loud ones who think market should go up every week in a straight line?submitted by/u/banff_lover[link][comments]
